name: Velocity-CTD
description: Velocity-CTD, derived from the Velocity egg, with GitHub release/build selection and a SHA-256-verified atomic boot updater. Uses the official bootstrap JAR and matching embedded CTD configuration. Requires Java 25+.
author: tommasobenatti@users.noreply.github.com

installation.content:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
apk add --no-cache curl jq coreutils unzip
cd /mnt/server
update_velocity_ctd() {
  for tool in curl jq sha256sum unzip; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: required tool $tool is missing; pull the refreshed runtime image." >&2; return 1; }
  done
  selector="${CTD_BUILD:-latest}"
  printf '%s' "$selector" | jq -Re 'test("^(latest|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})$")' >/dev/null || { echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: CTD_BUILD must be latest or a build number." >&2; return 1; }
  api="https://api.github.com/repos/GemstoneGG/Velocity-CTD/releases/latest"
  if [ "$selector" != "latest" ]; then api="https://api.github.com/repos/GemstoneGG/Velocity-CTD/releases/tags/build-$selector"; fi
  release_json=$(curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "$api") || return 1
  tag=$(printf '%s' "$release_json" | jq -er 'select(.draft == false) | .tag_name | select(type == "string" and test("^build-[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$"))') || return 1
  build=$(printf '%s' "$tag" | cut -d- -f2)
  [ "$selector" = "latest" ] || [ "$selector" = "$build" ] || return 1
  asset=$(printf '%s' "$release_json" | jq -ec --arg build "$build" '.assets | map(select(.name | test("^velocity-ctd-[0-9][0-9A-Za-z._+-]*-" + $build + "\\.jar$"))) | select(length == 1) | .[0]') || { echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: release has no unique bootstrap JAR." >&2; return 1; }
  filename=$(printf '%s' "$asset" | jq -er '.name') || return 1
  version=$(printf '%s' "$filename" | jq -Rr --arg build "$build" 'sub("^velocity-ctd-"; "") | sub("-" + $build + "\\.jar$"; "")') || return 1
  sha256=$(printf '%s' "$asset" | jq -er '.digest | select(type == "string" and test("^sha256:[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$")) | sub("^sha256:"; "")') || { echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: GitHub release asset has no valid SHA-256 digest." >&2; return 1; }
  url=$(printf '%s' "$asset" | jq -er '.browser_download_url') || return 1
  [ "$url" = "https://github.com/GemstoneGG/Velocity-CTD/releases/download/$tag/$filename" ] || return 1
  current=$(cat .velocity-ctd-build 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$current" = "$tag" ] && [ -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] Version $version build $build is already installed."
    return 0
  fi
  echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] Downloading version $version, build $build..."
  echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] $url"
  curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o "$jar.download" "$url" || return 1
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha256" "$jar.download" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || return 1
  unzip -tq "$jar.download" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  mv -f "$jar.download" "$jar" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$tag" > .velocity-ctd-build || return 1
  echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] Version $version build $build installed and SHA-256 verified."
}
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-velocity.jar}"
case "$jar" in
  .*|-*|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|"") echo "[Velocity-CTD Installer] ERROR: invalid JAR filename."; exit 1 ;;
esac
mkdir -p .pterodactyl
cat > .pterodactyl/velocity-ctd-start.sh <<'PTERO_VELOCITY_CTD_START'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
cd /home/container || exit 1
update_velocity_ctd() {
  for tool in curl jq sha256sum unzip; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: required tool $tool is missing; pull the refreshed runtime image." >&2; return 1; }
  done

  printf '%s' "$selector" | jq -Re 'test("^(latest|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})$")' >/dev/null || { echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: CTD_BUILD must be latest or a build number." >&2; return 1; }
  api="https://api.github.com/repos/GemstoneGG/Velocity-CTD/releases/latest"
  if [ "$selector" != "latest" ]; then api="https://api.github.com/repos/GemstoneGG/Velocity-CTD/releases/tags/build-$selector"; fi
  release_json=$(curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "$api") || return 1
  tag=$(printf '%s' "$release_json" | jq -er 'select(.draft == false) | .tag_name | select(type == "string" and test("^build-[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$"))') || return 1
  build=$(printf '%s' "$tag" | cut -d- -f2)
  [ "$selector" = "latest" ] || [ "$selector" = "$build" ] || return 1
  asset=$(printf '%s' "$release_json" | jq -ec --arg build "$build" '.assets | map(select(.name | test("^velocity-ctd-[0-9][0-9A-Za-z._+-]*-" + $build + "\\.jar$"))) | select(length == 1) | .[0]') || { echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: release has no unique bootstrap JAR." >&2; return 1; }
  filename=$(printf '%s' "$asset" | jq -er '.name') || return 1
  version=$(printf '%s' "$filename" | jq -Rr --arg build "$build" 'sub("^velocity-ctd-"; "") | sub("-" + $build + "\\.jar$"; "")') || return 1
  sha256=$(printf '%s' "$asset" | jq -er '.digest | select(type == "string" and test("^sha256:[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$")) | sub("^sha256:"; "")') || { echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: GitHub release asset has no valid SHA-256 digest." >&2; return 1; }
  url=$(printf '%s' "$asset" | jq -er '.browser_download_url') || return 1
  [ "$url" = "https://github.com/GemstoneGG/Velocity-CTD/releases/download/$tag/$filename" ] || return 1
  current=$(cat .velocity-ctd-build 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$current" = "$tag" ] && [ -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] Version $version build $build is already installed."
    return 0
  fi
  echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] Downloading version $version, build $build..."
  echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] $url"
  curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o "$jar.download" "$url" || return 1
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha256" "$jar.download" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || return 1
  unzip -tq "$jar.download" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  mv -f "$jar.download" "$jar" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$tag" > .velocity-ctd-build || return 1
  echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] Version $version build $build installed and SHA-256 verified."
}
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-velocity.jar}"
case "$jar" in
  .*|-*|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|"") echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: invalid JAR filename."; exit 1 ;;
esac
auto_update="${AUTO_UPDATE:-1}"
if [ "$auto_update" = "1" ] || [ "$auto_update" = "true" ]; then
  if ! update_velocity_ctd; then
    rm -f "$jar.download"
    if [ ! -s "$jar" ]; then echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: update failed and no runnable JAR exists."; exit 1; fi
    echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] WARNING: update failed; starting the existing JAR."
  fi
else
  echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] Automatic updates are disabled."
  if [ ! -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: $jar does not exist."
    exit 1
  fi
fi
prepare_velocity_ctd_config() {
  [ ! -s velocity.toml ] || return 0
  mkdir -p .pterodactyl || return 1
  if ! unzip -p "$jar" default-velocity.toml > velocity.toml.download 2>/dev/null; then
    unzip -p "$jar" 'jar-in-jar/velocity-proxy-*.jar' > .pterodactyl/ctd-proxy.jar.download || return 1
    unzip -p .pterodactyl/ctd-proxy.jar.download default-velocity.toml > velocity.toml.download || return 1
  fi
  rm -f .pterodactyl/ctd-proxy.jar.download
  [ -s velocity.toml.download ] || return 1
  mv -f velocity.toml.download velocity.toml
}
if ! prepare_velocity_ctd_config; then
  rm -f velocity.toml.download .pterodactyl/ctd-proxy.jar.download
  echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: unable to read the default CTD configuration from the JAR."
  exit 1
fi
port="${SERVER_PORT:-25565}"
case "$port" in *[!0-9]*|"") echo "[Velocity-CTD Updater] ERROR: invalid server port."; exit 1 ;; esac
[ "$port" -ge 1 ] && [ "$port" -le 65535 ] || exit 1
sed -i -E 's|^bind[[:space:]]*=.*$|bind = "0.0.0.0:'"${SERVER_PORT:-25565}"'"|' velocity.toml
exec java ${JAVA_FLAGS:--Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=95.0 -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=4M -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:MaxInlineLevel=15} -jar "$jar"
PTERO_VELOCITY_CTD_START
chmod 755 .pterodactyl/velocity-ctd-start.sh
prepare_velocity_ctd_config() {
  [ ! -s velocity.toml ] || return 0
  mkdir -p .pterodactyl || return 1
  if ! unzip -p "$jar" default-velocity.toml > velocity.toml.download 2>/dev/null; then
    unzip -p "$jar" 'jar-in-jar/velocity-proxy-*.jar' > .pterodactyl/ctd-proxy.jar.download || return 1
    unzip -p .pterodactyl/ctd-proxy.jar.download default-velocity.toml > velocity.toml.download || return 1
  fi
  rm -f .pterodactyl/ctd-proxy.jar.download
  [ -s velocity.toml.download ] || return 1
  mv -f velocity.toml.download velocity.toml
}
if ! update_velocity_ctd || ! prepare_velocity_ctd_config; then
  rm -f "$jar.download" velocity.toml.download .pterodactyl/ctd-proxy.jar.download
  echo "[Velocity-CTD Installer] ERROR: unable to install Velocity-CTD."
  exit 1
fi

variables.name: Velocity-CTD Build
variables.description: Use latest to follow the newest GitHub release, or a build number such as 402 to pin it. The updater logs the CTD version, build number and exact JAR URL. Pinned releases must provide a SHA-256 digest.

variables.name: Velocity-CTD JAR File
variables.description: JAR filename used by the updater and startup command.

variables.name: Update on Boot
variables.description: Check GitHub Releases before every start. Failed API requests or invalid downloads preserve the existing JAR. Set to 0 to disable updates.

variables.name: JVM Flags
variables.description: Velocity's recommended G1 flags combined with Pterodactyl-aware memory sizing.
